note: Versioned WorkItem store — every update appends a full record, so the file grows O(items x versions); observed 31MB/853 lines for 101 items with 240KB lines from embedded attempt history. Compaction folds to latest-per-item_id and archives the pre-compaction file under work-coordination/compaction-archive/ (the writer runs as infrastructure_sentinel, which cannot write active/archive/). The parent dir stays review_required (leases/boards untouched). MSN-STORE-BOUNDS-2: self_managed — the janitor must not fold it by plain item_id: createWorkItemIfAbsent compares a replay against the creation (version 1) snapshot and treats several version-1 snapshots as ambiguous ownership. The writer compacts at write time inside the coordination mutation fence (work-coordination-ledger.ts workItemCompactionKey: version-1 rows kept verbatim, later versions folded by item_id; WORK_ITEMS_COMPACT_MIN_BYTES 2 MiB). The old inline 64MB non-atomic fold is gone. Readers stream (strict: a malformed line fails closed by contract).
